notes: Files now travel in pieces: a transfer that is interrupted carries on where it stopped, big files come from everyone who has them at once, and chats never wait behind a file. New File Box at the bottom of the chat list: a shared box of files for the people you pick, with roles and a size cap; it shows everything in it and downloads only what you ask for, unless you switch on keep-downloaded. Two friends whose routers refuse a direct connection can now reach each other through a friend they share, who sees only encrypted bytes. The public relay can be switched off.
